scientific_changes.description: Gaussian blur is a disclosed display encoding driven by the real SCF residual; raw densities are retained unchanged.

transformations: residual-mapped Gaussian blur for display only

problems.scientific_expression: The previous concept sampled only a few SCF states and did not make it visually evident that every surface came from a real RHF density iterate.
problems.geometry: The previous near-axial water-dimer view compressed the H-O-H geometry and made several force arrows disappear behind atomic spheres.
problems.annotations: The earlier SCF labels crowded the density object and the relationship between the four electronic steps and the outer MD loop was ambiguous.
problems.readability: Dark red force arrows were too close to the oxygen color and too short to read reliably at A4 scale.
problems.submission_quality: The prior assets mixed provisional projections with stale source panels and lacked a traceable all-iteration Cube provenance set.

review.action: Recomputed and retained all 19 RHF/STO-3G density matrices on one fixed grid; rendered every Cube, molecule, and force arrow through MatterVis; changed to an asymmetric dimer camera; offset and enlarged pale dusty-rose force arrows; simplified the SCF loop to four nodes outside the structure; moved the solve-orbitals label inward to preserve print clearance; and regenerated independent A4 source panels with provenance sidecars.
